events.title_zh: Iraq plans cabinet reshuffle targeting three ministers, source says
events.title_original: Iraq plans cabinet reshuffle targeting three ministers, source says
events.summary: Shafaq News- Baghdad   Iraq’s government and political parties have agreed to reshuffle Prime Minister Ali Al-Zaidi’s cabinet after the draft budget is settled, with the oil, transport, and communications ministers likely to be the first three replaced, a government source told Shafaq News on Monday.  The source said there was “near consensus” on replacing the three ministers, citing health reasons for the transport minister and failures in several areas for Oil Minister Basim Al-Abadi. The source gave no specific reason for replacing the communications minister.  （原文待翻译）
